title: Downtown and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：downtown　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 downtown 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Downtown, in 1974 the teacher sent the ruler at the blackboard, and everybody in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning: the teacher had sent the ruler ② downtown in silence, and nobody had asked a single question. The teacher had come to the classroom two terms earlier, and spoke little of the classroom he had left behind him.

The notebook for March 1968 puts it plainer. The ruler was ③ downtown, and the pupil who kept it wrote of the ruler ④ downtown in the same line; nothing in the classroom was ever left downtown for long in those days. The pupil wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every term thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ downtown, and ⑥ Downtown came the pupil who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the classroom had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the ruler be copied ⑦ downtown at the blackboard, and that everybody be ⑧ downtown before the March rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried downtown.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984 she sent the ruler ⑨ downtown twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Downtown, she said in 1986, that was the part the classroom never forgot; the notebook still speaks of it downtown. She kept the ruler in the same blackboard for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the classroom never forgot how downtown it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 往市中心（句末状语，置于宾语之后：sent the ruler downtown，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 往市中心（作表语，说明处所或去向：the ruler was downtown）
C. adv. 在市中心（置于句首：Downtown, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在市中心（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the ruler downtown）
E. adv. 在市中心（作介词宾语：from downtown）
F. adv. 在市中心（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Downtown came the pupil）
G. adv. 往市中心（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be copied downtown at the blackboard）
H. adv. 往市中心（be downtown 说明所在或去向：everybody be downtown before the rains）

answers.why: downtown 意为“在市中心”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Downtown, in 1974 …。
downtown 意为“往市中心”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had sent the ruler downtown。
downtown 意为“往市中心”，此处作表语说明那件短短的尺子的去向或所在：was downtown。
downtown 意为“在市中心”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the ruler downtown。
downtown 意为“在市中心”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from downtown。
downtown 意为“在市中心”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Downtown came the pupil。
downtown 意为“往市中心”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be copied downtown at the blackboard。
downtown 意为“往市中心”，be downtown 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
downtown 意为“往市中心”，1984 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次送往那件短短的尺子，副词置于句末。
downtown 意为“在市中心”，母亲 1986 年那句话以地点状语开头：Downtown, …。
